title: ZX Bank – Beach Road ATMs List (Major Indian Cities)

nodes.title: Mumbai – Maharashtra
nodes.summary: Seven beach-side ATMs in Mumbai: Marine Drive (Chowpatty End), Juhu Beach (Juhu Tara Road), Girgaum Chowpatty, Versova Beach (Andheri West), Carter Road Promenade (Bandra West), Aksa Beach (Malad West) and Dadar Chowpatty (Veer Savarkar Marg).

nodes.title: Chennai – Tamil Nadu
nodes.summary: Seven ATMs near Chennai beaches: Marina Beach (near Gandhi Statue, Kamarajar Salai), Elliot's Beach (Besant Nagar Promenade), Thiruvanmiyur Beach, Neelankarai Beach (East Coast Road), Palavakam Beach (SH 49), Santhome Beach and Kovalam Beach (Chennai suburb).

nodes.title: Visakhapatnam – Andhra Pradesh
nodes.summary: Seven beach-road ATMs in Visakhapatnam: RK Beach, Rushikonda Beach, Lawsons Bay Colony, Tenneti Park Beach, Yarada Beach (Gajuwaka), Sagar Nagar Beach and Bheemili Beach.

nodes.title: Kolkata – West Bengal
nodes.summary: Seven ATMs at beaches around Kolkata (Digha, the nearest beach, is a few hours away): Digha, Mandarmani, Tajpur, Shankarpur, Bakkhali, Henry's Island and Sagardwip, across Purba Medinipur and South 24 Parganas.
